_source: foundational_documents/The_Whole_DOT_spec.txt §2 (execution order) and §3 (constant registry). READ FROM THE SPEC, NOT RETYPED FROM A PROMPT - the spec is the source of truth and every constant there carries a derivation and a status label.
_depth_floor_note: DERIVED, per direction independently. The d2->d3 cliff: LONG 16.55% -> 8.75%, SHORT 12.54% -> 5.40%. Same value both sides because two independent measurements agree, not because a threshold was imposed.
_admission_note: DERIVED. The only buildable rule. CURRENT opened 9,356 trades and deleted them post-hoc; ATOMIC refused 189 valid events for $20,373.
_max_positions_note: SWEPT. 21 is the LAST SAFE VALUE - the margin is ONE SLOT WIDE (§8.1).
_global_gate_note: SWEPT. Raw ATR at the entry bar, not a percentile. A risk dial with no optimum; 20 is the knee.
_tier_note: tier = min(depth, 5). Thresholds are mechanism-D adaptive percentiles at the entry bar. TIER 1 AND TIER 2 ARE NOT CARRIED - they are unreachable under a floor of 3 and the spec states a build must not carry them. SHORT d4/d5+ are FREE by measurement (§5.3), not by inheritance.
_conviction_note: recentfb FALSE is DERIVED - DISABLED ON MEASUREMENT. It sized losers up more than winners (winners 1.256->1.183, losers 1.186->1.094) and removing it takes 20% off the worst bar. master.py L1005 hardcoded it TRUE.
_base_lot_note: §6 is quoted at 1.0 lot base. The adopted live figure is 0.30; scaling is exact because the engine fills at the same price regardless of lot size.
